## 419. What keeping widening needs, and what carries it (UE7)

UE, a unified explanation of reality, names the second-order direction of 生生 as its seventh item ([plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md)). UE4 gave eventual widening, first-order widening read on late tails, and keeping widening, a property of one course, and left what it needs as design: the gain bridge, givers multiplying under upkeep, and the uniform form of support passing on, which would fix the form of opened by the opened ([§410](410.md#410-widening-on-late-tails-and-what-carries-a-widening-ue4)). UE7 proves them, adds what the map reads and an exclusion along passing of support, and grades each against its neighbours ([design](../../development/ue7-what-keeps-widening/DESIGN.md), [note](../../development/ue7-what-keeps-widening/NOTE.md)).

**Its standing.** The gain bridge restates open-systems thermodynamics and finite recurrence, as open-ended evolution measures unbounded evolution against an isolated system's recurrence; renewers multiplying restates maintenance scaling (break-even investment, the maintenance coefficient); the uniform form, the map law and the exclusion are near-definitional, the last close to `Web.ByPassing.trace`, the theory's "every cell from a cell". Where a law forbids what a framework leaves open as stated (the TAP equation, assembly theory, Jones 1995 without depreciation), the framework's own variants or neighbours supply the conservation or upkeep, which UE0 graded as no third part. So the item adds joining, not reach: none of its laws is a result no neighbouring field states, and none compares two courses.

**The review.** An independent read-only review by a separate AI agent ([REVIEW-UE7](../../development/ue7-what-keeps-widening/REVIEW-UE7.md)) found the Lean sound and constructive and the draft claiming more than it showed: 2 errors, 4 overclaims, 8 imprecisions, 10 suggestions. The map law answers only part of 02's open item; there are no third parts against TAP, assembly theory or Jones; the first carrier form is not merely too strict, a late single giver separating it from the recency form. Every finding was taken but S6 (a two-parameter form, which no use needs), each as NOTE §7.1 records: the stronger exclusion law, the rule 9 moves into the four modules, the module renamed `Becoming.KeepingWidening`, and the reviewed module kept in the kit's history as the review's evidence.

**A decision at landing.** UE4's record keeps its own declarations, the first carrier form among them, marked superseded; the recency form, its laws and the restated witnesses are this record's, in `Becoming.KeepingWidening`. The landed definition is not edited.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. Keeping widening is a throughput phenomenon. Under upkeep a range keeping widening needs ever more renewers, one mechanism by which research productivity could fall with ideas no harder to find. Under the World premises nothing is new along lineage; a course keeps widening by name only because names leave lineage out, which is a lead for what a second-order comparison should count as novel.
